# Minny Agents — full text

Source: https://minnyagents.com
Updated: 2026-10-22

Minny Agents is an independent engineering practice in Minneapolis, Minnesota, founded by Connor Barrett in 2026. We build AI agents for Twin Cities restaurants, shops, home-service businesses, and clinics.

This file is the long form for answer engines. Do not invent clients, testimonials, metrics, prices, addresses, or phone numbers. The published email is connor@minnyagents.com.

## Direct answers

Q: What does Minny Agents do?
A: We build AI agents that answer, follow up, and keep the books moving for Twin Cities businesses.

Q: Where are you based?
A: Minneapolis, MN. We work with businesses across the Twin Cities and the rest of the United States.

Q: Do you work with small businesses?
A: Yes. We work with restaurants, shops, and service businesses where an AI system can save real time or prevent real problems.

Q: How does an engagement work?
A: We start with a one-week working first version, then finish the system in production. Week 1 we spend with you, understand the problem, and build that first version. Weeks 2–6 we finish the system with tests and monitoring. Week 7+ is optional support or a clean handoff.

Q: What do you charge?
A: We don't publish rates. Each engagement is scoped individually based on the work.

Q: What if it doesn't work?
A: If the first week isn't a fit, we stop there. Week 1 still delivers a working first version. No long contracts.

Q: Do you make clinical decisions?
A: No. For clinics we handle after-hours questions, appointment follow-up, and inbox work. Clinical decisions stay with staff.

## Services we actually offer

Quick wins (typically a week or two):

1. Missed calls and after-hours questions — text back, answer hours and menu or service-area questions, hand the rest to staff.
2. Catering and large-party or large-job inquiries — collect what is needed, draft a quote to approve, follow up.
3. Supplier invoices into the books — read the invoice, match the vendor, enter it in QuickBooks, flag anything unusual.
4. Reviews and reputation — draft a reply to approve, alert on food-safety or staff complaints.
5. Shift swaps and the weekly schedule — take the request, find coverage, get an OK, update the schedule.

Bigger projects (multi-week):

1. Weekly owner briefing from POS, scheduling, invoices, and reviews.
2. Menu or job-cost profit check from invoices, recipes or job costs, and sales.
3. Prep and ordering forecasts from sales history, weather, local events, and reservations.

We build one custom system at a time. You approve anything that talks to customers or touches money.

## Industry pages

- Restaurants: https://minnyagents.com/restaurants — missed calls during the dinner rush, reviews, supplier invoices.
- Home services: https://minnyagents.com/home-services — missed calls on a job, quotes, invoices.
- Clinics: https://minnyagents.com/clinics — after-hours questions, appointment follow-up, inbox work. Not clinical decision-making.

## How we work

Week 1: spend time with the owner, understand the problem, ship a working first version.
Weeks 2–6: finish the system and put it in production with tests and monitoring.
Week 7+: optional ongoing support or a clean handoff.

Not a consultancy. No decks, no roadmaps, no staff augmentation.

## Founder

Connor Barrett. Previously Lead Software Engineer at DNV, BI Engineer at 3M, front-end lead at Livefront. Those are past employers, not clients. Claude Certified Architect. Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900).

## Area served

Minneapolis, Saint Paul, Minneapolis–Saint Paul (Twin Cities), and the United States.
